headline: Warden Gains at Linn Mercy Erased as Nevish Line Ignites
war_summary: The Warden footholds reported at Linn Mercy in the last edition have been wiped from the ledger: that district now stands ten Colonial works to none, with one still unclaimed, and its fighting has eased off its morning pitch. The heat has shifted to the Nevish Line, which has become the sharpest station on the board. Its count now reads five Warden works, three Colonial and none unclaimed, one former no-man's-land work having passed to Colonial hands, and with four actions in six hours and casualties past 300 Colonial and 450 Warden in the past hour, both still climbing. In the Weathered Expanse the Colonials have added two more works, leaving five to one Warden and three unclaimed; nine actions in two hours and fifty-five across the day make it the busiest district anywhere. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, Checkpoint Bua alone the scene of twenty-one actions. Mooring County remains brisk at eleven Warden works and one unclaimed, twenty-three actions in the day. Callahan's Passage stays the costliest posting, near 79 Colonial and 70 Warden losses in the last hour. The wider map is still overwhelmingly Colonial, Warden strength massed in the north and west.
